name: Wineteer Construction

items.title: The homepage is heavy on a phone
items.detail: Scrolling the homepage downloads about 6 MB. Most fast sites stay under 3 MB, so on cell data it drags.
items.fix: Resize and compress the photos (and load the ones further down only when needed), so the page opens fast on cell data.

good: There is a form on the homepage
Has a search description for Google
